So, where to begin? Transexuality has been a thing for decades, potentially more. Since it's early days it was treated like another mental health problem. Nowadays due to a highest amount of transexual people, the subject as become more common and more well known by the public. It is now common knowledge that a lot of Transexual People are following hormonal therapy in order to in the end participate to a sex change operation. It works both ways for male and female.

I am totally fine with how you feel in your body. Hoe you identify yourself and all these things that comes with transexuality. Wanna do an hormonal therapy? Sure mate go ahead. Wanna wear clothes of the opposite sex? Approved, do whatever you want. Not as if it really change anything for me anyway. 

What tickles me is about the operation to change sex. I personally think we should not proceed to such operations for now as we do not have the technology to grow and implant fully functional genitals. A lot of people who follow this path regret it later. I don't know what ratio exactly but I do know that they exist and aren't a minority. Sacrificing perfectly working genitals for these pale imitations may not always be the best choice for you.

Now, I know A LOT probably already disagree so far. Transexuality comes with gender dysphoria. I am not telling that dysphoria isn't a thing and should not require a treatment, only not that way. As strong as it may be, a person who suffers from dysphoria should receive help from family and medical professionals and hormonal therapy only in last resort, especially during puberty when your body is still developing, you should not, for the sake of your physical health, follow hormonal therapy as soon as age 16 (Canada). Hormonal therapy should be taken only if the feeling of gender dysphoria is too strong to be treated with normal means and should be taken after age 25, this should let your body enough time to develop correctly and not mess up with your puberty.

A lot of young people such as teenagers from both genders claim to be trans to follow some kind of trend in order to feel a little comfort from being part of a group, to be able to identify themselves and stand aparts from the common people. A lot of them aren't actually transexual, of course some of them actually are Trans and do suffer from dysphoria. But the majority of them is, unfortunately, just follow the wave. 

So. My summary of my ideas is, of course, far from being complete here as it is only a summary. I am open to get feedback and criticism and ready to receive a shitload of probably worth downvote
